parts:
ggtree is great!

I have a heatmap showing nucleotide differences between the samples that I sequenced. 

My heatmap, however, has columns that are out of order (see attached). 

I want to arrange the columns of my heatmap (x-axis) to the same order as the rows of my heatmap (y-axis). 

How is this done?

How the graph was made:
tree <- read.newick("tree.iqtree.treefile")
thetree <- ggtree(tree)

distances <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(alignment_dist))
gheatmap(thetree, distances, colnames = FALSE)
